name: PageTemplate
description: A standardized layout template for front-end (non-admin) pages that provides consistent structure, spacing, and layout options. It includes the PageTransition component to ensure smooth transitions between pages.
usage: Use for front-end (non-admin) pages to maintain consistent layout structure
In 'single-column' and 'two-column-equal' layouts, the H1 title is rendered above the content
In 'two-column-sidebar-right' and 'two-column-sidebar-left' layouts, the title is rendered within the main content column (the children prop column)
Use 'sidebar' prop only with 'two-column-sidebar-right' or 'two-column-sidebar-left' layouts
Control sidebar width using 'sidebarColumns' prop (1-5 columns out of 12-column grid, defaults to 4)
Set maxWidth to false for full-width pages that need to expand to viewport width
Use backLink and backLinkTitle props to add navigation breadcrumb to the heading

design: The template automatically handles responsive padding and margins

Title Placement: The H1 title is rendered above the content in 'single-column' and 'two-column-equal' layouts. In 'two-column-sidebar-right' and 'two-column-sidebar-left' layouts, the title is rendered within the main content column (the children prop column)
Layout Structure for 'single-column': Renders children below the title
Layout Structure for 'two-column-equal': Renders children in the left column and secondColumn content in the right column, below the title

Layout Structure for 'two-column-sidebar-left': Renders sidebar content in a left column (width determined by sidebarColumns, default lg:col-span-4) and children (including the title) in a right column (width 12 - sidebarColumns)

Layout Structure for 'two-column-sidebar-right': Renders children (including the title) in a left column (width 12 - sidebarColumns) and sidebar content in a right column (width determined by sidebarColumns, default lg:col-span-4)
The template internally uses Tailwind Grid for layouts involving columns
When maxWidth is true, content is constrained to max-w-7xl
When maxWidth is false, content will expand to the full width of its container
Includes PageTransition component for smooth transitions
Back link option is part of the Heading component
No top padding on mobile since desktop nav is hidden on mobile
fullViewportMobile option removes padding on mobile for full-viewport content (useful for photo galleries)
accessibility: Title is rendered as an H1 heading for proper document structure
Back link includes backLinkTitle prop for accessibility context
Uses semantic HTML elements (main, aside) for proper document structure

props.name: title
props.description: Title for the page (H1 heading). Position depends on layout.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Content for the sidebar (used only with 'two-column-sidebar-right' or 'two-column-sidebar-left' layouts).

props.name: secondColumn
props.description: Content for the second column (used only with 'two-column-equal' layout).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Whether to constrain the page width to max-w-7xl.

props.name: className
props.description: Custom CSS classes applied to the main page wrapper element.

props.name: backLink
props.description: Optional back link URL for the heading.

props.name: backLinkTitle
props.description: Optional back link title for accessibility.

props.name: sidebarColumns
props.description: Number of columns (out of 12) for the sidebar in sidebar layouts (lg breakpoint).

props.name: asciiTitle
props.description: Use ASCII art header instead of regular heading. Options: 'Matt Quinn', 'Work', 'Photos', 'Journal', 'Dashboard', 'Admin', 'Sign In'.

props.name: asciiColorVariant
props.description: Color variant for ASCII header: 'gradient' or 'secondary' (defaults to 'secondary' for sub-pages).

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Hide the title (useful when title is rendered inside content, e.g. bento grids).

props.name: fullViewportMobile
props.description: Remove padding on mobile for full-viewport content (e.g. photo galleries).

props.name: showBar
props.description: Show/hide the decorative accent bar on the heading.

props.name: compactTitle
props.description: Reduce spacing between title and content for denser layouts.
